authentication: Configure an approved bearer token or API-key header outside this file.
notes: Enterprise plan and team admin access required.
The endpoint must be publicly reachable over HTTPS; do not enter a loopback address.
Use the base URL without /v1; Cursor appends /v1/logs and /v1/metrics.
Run Test connection, then Enable in the admin UI.
Review telemetry family switches and auto_enable_new_families before enabling.
The collector forwards to a same-host Lens listener labeled cursor-runtime; keep source pipelines separate.
Cursor does not export gRPC or HTTP/JSON. A collector may translate the wire encoding.
Cloud Agent conversation-content coverage does not imply IDE or CLI transcript coverage.
